exploit_name: Incorrect proportional reward splits when an operator has been slashed
description: When an operator is slashed, the reward distribution formula doesn't correctly adjust proportions for remaining operators.
root_cause: When an operator is slashed, the reward distribution formula doesn't correctly adjust proportions for remaining operators.
fix_description: Recompute reward proportions dynamically when slashing occurs.
notes: Operators receive incorrect reward amounts after slashing events.
